claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Xylazine is an alpha2-adrenergic agonist with no known cytotoxic pharmacophore; at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is expected to produce little or no selective cancer cell killing, with any weak effect likely reflecting nonspecific cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress rather than a receptor-mediated mechanism.
